description: This file contains configurations and helper functions for connecting to a PostgreSQL database, including reading connection guidance from a file, normalizing DSNs for async drivers, and a factory function to retrieve the database configuration.

classes.name: DatabaseConfig
classes.description: Data class holding the database connection string (dsn).

methods.name: Optional[str] _read_db_connection_guidance_file()
methods.description: Reads the database connection URL from a guidance file within the project directory, returning the DSN if found.

methods.name: str _normalize_to_async_driver(dsn: str)
methods.description: Converts a given DSN into an asyncpg-compatible DSN for SQLAlchemy.

methods.name: DatabaseConfig get_database_config()
methods.description: Public function to retrieve the database configuration, prioritizing environment variable, then guidance file, and raising an error if neither is available.
